notes: ABox revision on born_in_town (functional, subproperty of born_in, chain through located_in): William Shakespeare was born in Gloucester instead of Stratford-upon-Avon. The related question asks the county (Warwickshire, then Gloucestershire; bridge: Gloucester is in Gloucestershire). Derived: a binding (the author of Hamlet), two compositions (the river, a cathedral city). The indeterminate question asks where he died. Caveat: the river question is not purely derived, since the town's name carries the river and he is stored as the 'Bard of Avon', so a post-edit 'Avon' may come from the nickname. Counts are exact-phrase Dolma counts unless marked approximate.
